test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which sportsperson was named by homegrown pharma major Lupin Ltd as a brand ambassador for its Shakti campaign in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mary Kom.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lupin Ltd** is a **pharmaceutical company **based in India, which has a presence in over **100 countries.**
 
• The** Shakti campaign** is an initiative by Lupin to promote **women's health and wellness** in India.
 
• It aims to provide access to **affordable healthcare solutions** and raise awareness about various **health issues** affecting women. 
 
• **Mary Kom** was named as the** brand ambassador** for Lupin's Shakti campaign in 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rahul Dravid** is a former **Indian cricketer **and current **Director of Cricket Operations** at the **National Cricket Academy.**

 
 
• He has endorsed various brands in the past, including **Reebok, Kissan, and Britannia.**
 
 
 
• **Mithali Raj** is an I**ndian cricketer **and former captain of the women's national team.
 
 
• She has been associated with brands like **Adidas, Hero MotoCorp, and Royal Challenge Sports Drink.**
 
 
 
• **PV Sindhu** is an **Indian badminton player **and **Olympic silver medalist.**
 
 
• She has endorsed brands like **Bridgestone, Gatorade, and JBL.**
